title: Compute requested rounded safe areas
description: Purely offset each validated rounded rectangular label boundary inward by a user-requested alignment-tolerance assumption in millimetres and return explicit radius confidence and diagnostics without claiming physical validity.
acceptanceCriteria: SafetyRequest accepts only finite non-negative requested tolerance values in millimetres
Safe area is the geometric inward offset of the exact label boundary, including known rounded corners
Zero, known, estimated, and unknown corner-radius inputs produce distinct typed outcomes
An impossible offset returns named constraints and no invalid polygon or negative radius
The result labels tolerance as user-requested and unvalidated rather than measured, calibrated, safe, or verified

steps.description: Define safety request and result values
steps.details: Add serializable millimetre tolerance, boundary identity, radius value/confidence, derived safe region, and diagnostic fields beside immutable layout geometry.
Use pure geometry to reduce rectangular extents and known radius consistently, preserving the shared origin and refusing non-finite, negative, or collapsed results.
Return distinct known, estimated, and unknown confidence outcomes; do not invent a radius or corner conclusion when geometry is unknown.
Test zero, square, known rounded, estimated rounded, unknown radius, extreme tolerance, negative, and non-finite requests with exact expected geometry or diagnostics.

technicalNotes: Keep this task under ten minutes by supporting the product's rounded-rectangle media model only.
Requested tolerance is an authoring assumption. No numeric tolerance is validated until gated physical evidence exists.
